description: Removes the four approved in-app database dumps of 8-11 Oct 2026 from MinIO after re-verifying them, and clears their records' file pointer. Default Mode=verify changes nothing. Mode=delete needs the confirmation phrase.

Mode.description: verify (default) changes nothing; delete removes the four files.

runCommand: set -euo pipefail
MODE='{{ Mode }}'
CONFIRM='{{ Confirm }}'
echo "mode: $MODE"
if [ "$MODE" = "delete" ] && [ "$CONFIRM" != "DELETE-4-OLD-DUMPS" ]; then echo "ABORT: the confirmation phrase is missing or wrong. Nothing was changed."; exit 3; fi
echo '== gate 1: the off-server backup is fresh and verified =='
STATUS=$(cat /opt/backups/offsite/last_status.json); echo "$STATUS"
echo "$STATUS" | grep -q '"ok":true' || { echo "ABORT: the last off-server backup is not green. Nothing was changed."; exit 4; }

AT=$(echo "$STATUS" | sed -n 's/.*"at":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); AGE=$(( $(date -u +%s) - $(date -u -d "$AT" +%s) )); echo "age of that backup: $AGE seconds"; [ "$AGE" -lt 100800 ] || { echo "ABORT: the last off-server backup is older than 28 hours. Nothing was changed."; exit 4; }
STAMP=$(echo "$STATUS" | sed -n 's/.*"stamp":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')

AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/opt/backups/offsite/aws_config AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 aws s3api head-object --bucket pentrix-erpx-backups-373384939117 --key "daily/$STAMP/SHA256SUMS" > /dev/null || { echo "ABORT: the S3 backup for $STAMP has no SHA256SUMS. Nothing was changed."; exit 4; }
echo "S3 backup $STAMP is complete (SHA256SUMS present)"
echo '== gate 1b: the four archive copies are in S3 and were verified by reading them back =='
export AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/opt/backups/offsite/aws_config AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1
echo '== gate 2: facts from the database (read-only) =='

facts() { docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -c "select json_build_object('rows', (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'status', status::text, 'size_bytes', size_bytes, 'sha256', sha256, 'storage_key', storage_key, 'started_at', started_at)), '[]'::json) from backup_jobs where id::text in ('60b5ddc6-ab6d-4dcb-a36b-9085908d5589','6d502c1b-d465-4690-848e-6b161f0099a1','6b693aff-1ca9-4d19-851d-1e585c63b0de','aec2d1b7-6673-4674-86c9-1832afe0db6b')), 'newest', (select coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) from (select id, status::text as status, size_bytes, storage_key, started_at from backup_jobs where status = 'completed' order by started_at desc limit 3) t))"; }
FACTS=$(facts)
echo '== gate 3: verify the files, then (delete mode only) remove them =='

printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /tmp/ro_delete.py
OUT=$(mktemp); RC=0
nice -n 19 ionice -c3 docker exec -i -e MODE="$MODE" -e DATA_JSON="$FACTS" erpx_api python - < /tmp/ro_delete.py > "$OUT" 2>&1 || RC=$?
grep -v '^SQL|' "$OUT" || true
[ "$RC" = "0" ] || { echo "STOPPED (code $RC). The lines above say exactly what, if anything, was done."; rm -f "$OUT" /tmp/ro_delete.py; exit "$RC"; }

if [ "$MODE" = "delete" ]; then grep '^SQL|' "$OUT" | sed 's/^SQL|//' > /tmp/ro_update.sql || true; if [ -s /tmp/ro_update.sql ]; then echo "== recording the removal (one transaction) =="; (echo "begin;"; cat /tmp/ro_update.sql; echo "commit;") | docker exec -i shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1; fi; rm -f /tmp/ro_update.sql; fi

if [ "$MODE" = "delete" ]; then CLEARED=$(docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -c "select count(*) from backup_jobs where id::text in ('60b5ddc6-ab6d-4dcb-a36b-9085908d5589','6d502c1b-d465-4690-848e-6b161f0099a1','6b693aff-1ca9-4d19-851d-1e585c63b0de','aec2d1b7-6673-4674-86c9-1832afe0db6b') and storage_key is null"); echo "records with their file pointer cleared: $CLEARED of 4"; [ "$CLEARED" = "4" ] || { echo "ERROR: the files were removed but not all four records were updated. Run Mode=delete again: it finishes the records and touches no file."; rm -f "$OUT" /tmp/ro_delete.py; exit 8; }; fi
rm -f "$OUT"
echo '== post-cleanup checks =='

docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -F " | " -c "select started_at::date, id, status, size_bytes, storage_key is null as file_pointer_cleared from backup_jobs where id::text in ('60b5ddc6-ab6d-4dcb-a36b-9085908d5589','6d502c1b-d465-4690-848e-6b161f0099a1','6b693aff-1ca9-4d19-851d-1e585c63b0de','aec2d1b7-6673-4674-86c9-1832afe0db6b') order by started_at"
docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -F " | " -c "select started_at, status, size_bytes, storage_key from backup_jobs order by started_at desc limit 4"
df -h / | tail -1
echo "containers: $(docker ps | awk 'NR>1' | wc -l) running, $(docker ps | grep -c unhealthy || true) unhealthy"
docker exec erpx_api curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health || echo "WARNING: the API health endpoint did not answer: check the application now"; echo

if [ "$MODE" = "delete" ]; then echo "== verify again: the four should read as already removed and the newest three present =="; FACTS=$(facts); nice -n 19 docker exec -i -e MODE=verify -e DATA_JSON="$FACTS" erpx_api python - < /tmp/ro_delete.py; fi
rm -f /tmp/ro_delete.py
echo DONE
